methodology: Current-session AV legislation is independently discovered across all 50 states and D.C. with Open States API v3. Results are deduplicated and normalized actions are used to derive progress status. The Observatory condenses the full available source abstract to lead with operative provisions rather than existing-law boilerplate; the uncondensed source abstract is retained in source_summary. Official legislature source URLs are retained where available.
source: Open States API v3 national AV bill discovery

state_bills.title: Automated Driving System Commercial Vehicles
state_bills.summary: The act prohibits using an automated driving system to drive a commercial motor vehicle unless an individual who holds a commercial driver's license is in the vehicle, monitors the vehicle's driving, and intervenes, if necessary, to avoid illegal or unsafe driving. The act does not apply to a light-duty vehicle or a truck-mounted attenuator.

The act does not apply to a light-duty vehicle or a truck-mounted attenuator.
state_bills.source_summary: The act prohibits using an automated driving system to drive a commercial motor vehicle unless an individual who holds a commercial driver's license is in the vehicle, monitors the vehicle's driving, and intervenes, if necessary, to avoid illegal or unsafe driving. state_bills.title: Autonomous vehicles; work group to conduct and assessment of workforce impacts, etc.
state_bills.summary: Directs the existing work group convened by the Secretary of Transportation regarding autonomous driving systems to (i) conduct an assessment of the workforce impacts created by autonomous vehicles, including an overview of job losses and gains; (ii) identify and include stakeholders and representatives from the auto manufacturing industry and labor representatives from the passenger and product carrier business; and (iii) conduct an assessment of labor impacts created by autonomous vehicles no later than November 1, 2026.
